caption: The camera orientation has shifted to the right, revealing a portion of the wall in the background. A white remote control has been added to the right side of the pink hair dryer. The blue disinfectant bottle on the left side has been replaced with a purple toy.
The polar bear on the right side of the frame, which was previously facing left with its head slightly lowered and eyes closed, is now looking to the left.

The squirrel on the left side of the image has disappeared. A new black bird appears in the background, standing on the grass behind the tree stump. The peanut that was originally in the squirrel's mouth is now placed on the tree stump.
The perspective of the image shifts to the right, revealing more of the scene.
The scene has become brighter. The red car in the distance on the right side of the frame is no longer visible. A yellow snowplow appears on the road in the distance.
The three people change from facing forward with their arms crossed in front of their chests to turning to the left side of the frame, with their backs to the camera.

The camera lens, which was previously in the lower left corner of the table, has been moved to the right side of the keyboard. The camera body that was originally on the left side of the table is now present in the scene. The black mouse has been rotated 90 degrees counterclockwise. The camera lens and body have been placed together on the desk. The blue-white notebook located above the monitor has disappeared.

The polar bear on the right side of the image, which was previously standing with its mouth open and tongue out, is now lying down with its head resting on the snow. The polar bear in the middle of the image has changed from lying on the snow to having its head resting on the back of the polar bear on the left.

A woman wearing a white T-shirt and blue pants appears in front of the stove on the right side of the kitchen, facing away from the camera towards the stove. The word "kitchen" in light blue letters has appeared on the wooden floor at the lower left corner of the scene.

The scene has been rotated 90 degrees clockwise. The green picnic blanket on the grass area in front of the waterfall changes to a red and white checkered picnic blanket with the word "Picnic" printed on it. The blue and white striped beach chair moves from the right side of the picnic mat to the left side. The two brown cups on the picnic mat are replaced by three red cups.
The scene is now more lit up. A person appears in the middle of the road, walking towards the camera and approaching the pedestrian crossing.
The scene has become more tilted.
The scene is now more lit up. The blackboard at the front of the classroom changes from being visible to invisible.

The chair on the right side of the round table has disappeared. The chair on the left side of the round table has also disappeared. The transparent glass water jug in the center of the table has been replaced by a white cup. The red kettle on the right side of the stove is now green. The brown clock hanging on the wall at the back left of the scene has disappeared.
The scene has become more illuminated.
